title: Adaptive embedding gateway: versioned onboarding, fallback routing, and storage-compatible migration
creator: Maya Kapoor
description: Deliver an "adaptive embedding gateway" component that enables safe onboarding of new embedding models and versioned model serving for the embeddings + reranking endpoints. Goals: (1) allow rollouts with incremental traffic and automatic fallback to prior versions when quality or latency regressions appear; (2) preserve read compatibility for previously stored vectors and provide a background migration path; (3) expose metrics and automated gates (quality drift, latency SLOs, cost delta) for rollout automation. This ticket covers API surface changes, routing policy engine, storage compatibility shim, CI/eval harness, and an operator playbook for deprecations.
acceptance_criteria: A/B canary rollout flow from 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback triggers
Gateway routes by model version with prioritized fallback in <50ms additional latency
Stored vectors remain queryable against new model versions via compatibility shim or are migrated with background reindexer
Golden evaluation suite (recall@k, cosine drift, rerank NDCG) runs during each rollout stage and passes configured thresholds
Dashboards show per-version p50/p95/p99 latency, cost-per-request, and quality regressions; alerts fire on threshold breach
Runbook for deprecation created: timelines, client notices, and forced migration steps
decision_log: 2025-01-22: Decided to implement a lightweight compatibility shim for model dimension changes rather than forcing immediate full re-embedding for all customers.
2025-01-28: Rollout policy will include both quality and latency gates; quality gate uses cosine drift + NDCG on a golden set, latency gate uses p95 delta > 20% as a trigger.
2025-02-04: Chose incremental background reindexer (queue-based, rate-limited) as migration strategy; customers can opt-in to accelerated migration.
2025-02-10: Implement version-aware prefixing in storage keys to allow hybrid serving while migration is ongoing.
tasks: Design gateway routing API and config schema (policy, thresholds, weight schedule)
Implement versioned route handler with fallback chain and fast path for same-dimension models
Build compatibility shim to normalize vectors between compatible dimension sets (projection layers)
Implement background reindexer service with rate limits, progress tracking, and cancellation
Extend eval harness: golden dataset, recall@k, NDCG, cosine-drift, and synthetic latency injection tests
Dashboards & alerts: create per-version views, SLOs, and automated rollback alerts
Create operator runbook and deprecation notice templates for customers
Add e2e tests and create staging canary on dedicated capacity for real traffic testing
Docs: API change notes, migration guide, and example SDK usage for pinning versions
timeline: 2025-01-28: API and policy schema design complete
2025-02-05: Prototype gateway + shim for internal testing
2025-02-12: Eval harness and dashboards integrated into CI
2025-02-26: Production canary and customer opt-in migration starts
2025-03-01: Target full rollout or rollback decision
notes: Avoid changes that require re-embedding everything at once; minimize incidental customer cost.
Projection layers for dimension mismatches should be small (low-rank) to limit added latency and memory.
Consider exposing a 'compatibility_score' in the API to explain fallback decisions to customers.
We must add a billing note for accelerated reindexing as an opt-in paid operation for large corpora.
